# Arachnids
Arachnids are a humanoid species with features resembling those of the common tarantula.
## Unique Abilities
### Sericulture
- Arachnids can create Websilk at the cost of getting hungrier. They (and only they) can craft bundles of websilk into various items, from clothing and shields to entire walls.
## Diet
- They can eat raw meat without any ill effects. - They will get [color=#FFA500]poisoned[/color] by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- They have two additional Pocket slots in their inventory. - Their unarmed attacks deal [color=#ec3a3a]Piercing[/color] damage instead of Blunt.
## Drawbacks
- They [color=#FFA500]suffocate 50% faster.[/color] - their Blue Blood [color=#FFA500]can't be metabolised from Iron[/color], being based on Copper instead.
## Arachnid Naming Conventions
Arachnids typically use names derived from the Latin scientific names of real-world invertebrate species. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Argyroneta Reticulatus - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Loxosceles Domesticus - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Trombicula Doremi - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Chaos Chaos - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Spider-Man - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Shelob
## Lore
Due to a tragedy which brought their origin world to the forgotten portion of history, many Arachnids have been placed in the circumstance of nomads. Their retaining of sericulture has allowed them much more ease in terms of survival, but other means were required in giving themselves a sense of identity. Many Arachnids find themselves placing a high value on interests of theirs as a result. To insult most Arachnids favorite food, for example, is a blow taken quite seriously.
